Do not paste full build/test output into hot state or the current tracker.

areas.last_outcome: Fixed LinuxCliToolRunner.RunAsync pipe-drain deadlock. Spawned child process had RedirectStandardError/Output=true but the pipes were never drained, so the OS pipe buffer (~64KB on POSIX) could fill and block the child on its next write, causing WaitForExit to time out and the capture to return a misleading null/failure even though the tool was healthy. Same anti-pattern previously fixed in MacOSClipboardService, LinuxClipboardService, and the MacOS AppleScript helpers. Fix: extracted RunCoreAsync that drains stderr via process.BeginErrorReadLine and stdout via a fire-and-forget ReadToEndAsync continuation; added a bounded process.WaitForExit(1000) after Kill so the async drainers finish reading the (now-broken) pipes before the using block disposes the process. Added internal TestAccessor exposing RunForTestAsync so tests can exercise the run helper without producing a real PNG. Added 4 regression tests: happy path, large-stderr 0-exit, large-stderr non-zero exit, and timeout. Bumped version 0.23.85 -> 0.23.86.

Then continue TFM mismatch in Common/Platform.Abstractions, plugin version pinning, and remaining capture pipeline edge cases.

GetHashCode() already included Alpha via HashCode.Combine, but == only compared H/S/B — violating the rule that equal objects must have equal hash codes. Added TestAccessor class for internal test access and 8 regression tests covering equality, operators, and hash code contract. Bumped version 0.23.76 -> 0.23.77.
last_runs.result: build 0 warnings/0 errors; tests 1031+34=1065 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped

last_runs.area: Media subsystem / FFmpeg concat demuxer file-path escaping regression tests
last_runs.summary: Added regression tests for EscapeConcatFilePath (private static method used by ConcatenateVideos). FFmpeg concat format uses file 'path' syntax where raw apostrophes in filenames break parsing; the escape converts ' to \'. Added 5 unit tests covering single/multiple/no quotes, empty string, leading/trailing quotes. Added TestAccessor class for test access without reflection. Added InternalsVisibleTo to XerahS.Media. Bumped version 0.23.74 -> 0.23.75.
